# Safara Shuttle

> Safara Shuttle is a private airport transfer and chauffeur service based in Mediouna, Greater Casablanca, Morocco. It drives travellers from Casablanca Mohammed V airport (CMN) and from Casablanca city to any city in Morocco, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, with a fixed price agreed before booking.

- Website: https://safarashuttle.com
- WhatsApp and phone: +212 6 61 52 15 19
- Email: support@safarashuttle.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/safra_shuttle/
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=6594830863827031958
- Address: Lot Assalam N°234, 29490 Mediouna, Grand Casablanca, Morocco, between Casablanca and Mohammed V airport
- Languages spoken: French, English, Arabic

## Services

- Airport transfers: Casablanca Mohammed V airport (CMN) to or from hotels, homes and offices in Casablanca, Mohammedia, Rabat and the rest of Morocco. The driver follows the flight and waits in arrivals with a name sign.
- City to city transfers from Casablanca: Rabat, Marrakech, Fes, Meknes, Tangier, Tetouan, Chefchaouen, Essaouira, Agadir, El Jadida, Kenitra, Beni Mellal and more, door to door.
- Chauffeur by the hour and day excursions.
- Groups, families, business travellers, seminars and golf or surf trips.

## Vehicles (recent, air-conditioned)

- Business sedan: Skoda Superb or similar, up to 3 passengers.
- Premium sedan: Mercedes-Benz E-Class or similar, up to 3 passengers.
- Comfort van: Mercedes-Benz Vito or similar, up to 7 passengers.
- Family van: Ford Tourneo Custom or similar, up to 8 passengers.
- Minibus: Mercedes-Benz Sprinter or similar, up to 17 passengers.

## Prices from Casablanca (MAD, per vehicle, one way)

Business sedan / van / premium sedan:

- Mohammed V airport to Casablanca city: 350 / 400 / 600
- Mohammedia: 500 / 600 / 700
- Rabat or El Jadida: 900 / 1000 / 1500
- Kenitra: 1400 / 1500 / 2000
- Beni Mellal: 1500 / 1700 / 2500
- Marrakech or Meknes: 1800 / 2000 / 2900
- Fes: 2200 / 2500 / 3500
- Essaouira: 2300 / 3000 / 4500
- Tetouan: 2300 / 2500 / 3700
- Tangier: 2400 / 2600 / 3800
- Chefchaouen: 2800 / 3400 / 5500
- Agadir: 3400 / 3400 / 5000

The exact price is shown on the website before booking and confirmed by WhatsApp and email.

## Booking and payment

- Book online at https://safarashuttle.com (choose route, date, time and passengers) or send a WhatsApp message to +212 6 61 52 15 19.
- Payment by card (TPE), bank transfer or cash.
- Confirmation by WhatsApp and by email.
